steps: Select an independently retained recovery catalogue and pinned bootstrap-source adapter kit to recover fishhat and the domain source into fresh private staging; the supplied adapters remain unqualified scaffolds.
Source bootstrap materializes Git only and does not activate recovered policy. Independently retain and verify the native Python/tool/dependency installation bundle before installing it.

If source or installation is unavailable, use ordinary SSH to an independently enrolled surviving host-ops/app-ops endpoint for bounded direct inspection and recovery. Destroyed hosts need replacement provisioning.
Keep Git-source recovery distinct from Forgejo database/attachments, encrypted secret generations, app datasets and native issuer recovery. No current directory is required.
